title: Residue Characteristic Bound for Kim Hypotheses
body_html:
Residue Characteristic Bound for Kim Hypotheses

For \(G=U(V)\) with \(n=\dim_D V\), Kim's hypotheses for tame supercuspidal exhaustion hold if \[ p\ge \max\{2n+1,e_D n+2\}. \] For a type I dual pair \((U(V),U(V'))\), the paper uses the first-occurrence bound on \(\dim_D V'\) to state a simultaneous lower bound for both groups.
proof_html: The proof checks Kim's hypotheses one by one: the exponential map and Moy-Prasad comparison follow from the ramification-index bound, the Bruhat-Tits hypotheses hold for classical groups, Howe factorization supplies the tameness hypothesis, and DeBacker nilpotent-orbit hypotheses follow from the larger characteristic inequality.
